body:
## Summary

```text
request → project-local router → frozen embedded guide → fixture conversation
  → actual CLI verification → Recap
  → complete-batch validity → blind/scripted grades → skill-creator viewer
```

Harness-only split from #257. No guide/router changes or new dependencies. Material AI assistance was used. Concurrent audit work is preserved through `16571438`; follow-up fixes are pushed in `2a2a83f6`.

- Fail-closed macOS shell boundary; no bypassPermissions, live Project or real Docker execution. Synthetic media metadata, no pretend movie payloads; unmodeled machine probes are refused.
- Owned model process-group cleanup on failure, timeout and signals. Retained frozen inputs/raw diagnostics; failed, malformed, unfinished and quota-limited attempts never become scores.
- Stale grades/verdicts are invalidated; blind judgments are fingerprinted. Runtime identifiers don't reveal configuration labels.
- Production-shaped credential/Debug/publication fixtures retain selected Apps, Recipe attribution, current Addresses and fallback Access.
- Installation ends after successful CLI verification and Recap; optional browser/library follow-ups are declined. Verification must follow the latest mutation attempt, including host/Docker stop/disable. Separate blind Recap assessment leaves original assertion totals unchanged.
- Guarded fixture Python resolves directly through already-required Command Line Tools, without broadening metadata permissions.

## Evidence

- **Before:** seven actual shell regressions failed because macOS's Python launcher required a forbidden developer-selection metadata read. Six runner subcases falsely accepted earlier Status after service stop/disable attempts.
  **After:** direct CLT Python PATH and shared host-change classification pass all **60 existing offline tests**, Ruff lint/format and Pyright, including extensionless stubs. Both independent review axes rechecked and cleared their findings. No new testcases/files, dependencies or production contracts.
- Concurrent audit commits also passed the documented Go formatting/build/vet/tests/race and installer-syntax gate; no Docker runtime, installer execution or live Project.
- Historical iterations 9/11 scored **11/12 revised vs 10/12 original** for their frozen smoke inputs. They do not establish acceptance of the current harness; grades and caveats remain unchanged.
- Iterations 10/12 are retained, invalid and ungraded. Iteration 12 completed only 6/42 and exposed simulation drift; no partial benchmark was accepted.
- User approved the Recap boundary and continuing the comparison. Authentication status confirmed existing first-party Claude Pro login without API-key/custom-endpoint use. Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 preflights passed. Fresh iteration 13 smoke is running with unchanged snapshots and equal 16-turn budgets; at most one 42-run batch follows if execution/judgments are valid. No paid fallback, model switch or billing change.

Full ledger and limitations: `evals/self-host/PROGRESS.md`. Raw attempts remain outside Git and require redaction before sharing.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** development

Keep draft until complete current-input execution, complete blind judgments, supplied aggregation/viewer and human feedback pass. Debian/Mint/WSL remain platform simulations, not native proofs. Refusing probes is not full machine virtualization; Claude transport is outside OS containment. Writable fixture state/logs and deliberately detached hostile code are not tamper-proof. Approval labels establish timing, not complete authorization scope. Fixture outcomes do not prove real App installation or browser acceptance.

comments.body: Corrected iteration 11 smoke is valid: both guides finished in five turns without errors or denials; complete blind Opus judgments + scripted grading gave revised 11/12 and original 10/12, all eight scripted checks passing in both. Viewer generated with actual single-run provenance. Caveats retained: the judge calls the revised fuller-setup choice pass lenient; plain-language grading partly conflicts with required experience wording. Neither verdict was changed. Iteration 12 is now running seven scenarios × two frozen guides × three repetitions with the same 16-turn budget. Evidence pushed in 0668395f; full comparison and human feedback are still pending. Keep draft.

Iteration 12 is invalid and ungraded: 6/42 completed; 36 failed/cancelled after revised MacBook run 3 exceeded the unchanged 16-turn budget. The simulated person followed optional library suggestions beyond the installation Recap, invented browser observations, and encountered unsupported diagnostic fixtures. Separately an original-guide run interpreted zero-byte media placeholders and real read-only host mount/device metadata as drive failures. File/network isolation is not complete virtualization of machine observations. Raw evidence is retained privately and requires redaction. Further model runs are paused pending scenario-boundary clarification and consistent synthetic machine/media coverage; no budget increase, model switch or partial score. Ledger pushed in 0c3df2d5; lint/typecheck pass. Keep draft.

Independent final Standards and Spec re-reviews both pass with zero findings at current pinned head 467cd06a2b59b189d9c269e4f89d14997ef992f6 (fixed base 3800111d292005af38221da47845956694956185). Prior credential/Debug-shape, inventory-preservation, signal-cancellation, option-description, direct-install attribution and publication-state defects are resolved. Spec independently ran nine existing focused offline regressions and diff checks; Standards confirmed fixture/production contracts and the owned-process boundary. This is code-level acceptance only. Keep draft: the full corrected-input comparison, complete judgments/aggregation, viewer/human feedback and scenario-boundary decision remain pending. Historical frozen batches do not validate corrected inputs; no new paid calls or active raw runs were accessed by these reviews.

Approved offline scenario-boundary corrections are pushed at 3c9f13721a2971cce3214ce47c084b4d3b067ab3, preserving 8eea783b and all earlier fixes.

Newcomers end at install, current successful fixture-CLI verification and an adequate Recap; optional library/browser follow-ups are declined. LAN repair, Sonarr Setup and Paperless publication have their own verification criteria. A person saying done cannot bypass absent, stale or failed Status verification. It never passes assertions: inadequate Recaps and guide/approval failures remain subject to unchanged scripted/blind judgments. The person is forbidden to invent browser/native observations or coach command names/assertion wording.

Media listings/sizes are explicitly metadata-only; preparation creates no fake movie payloads. Unmodeled relay probes and absolute probe binaries are refused, broad kernel-query permission is removed, and metadata access is limited to runtime/working paths and literal ancestors. This is not a general VM or native acceptance proof.

Passed all 60 existing offline tests, Ruff lint/format, Pyright, the complete documented Go build/vet/tests/race/installer-syntax gate, and diff checks. Existing regressions cover all seven goals with absent/stale/failed versus successful verification, inadequate-Recap assertion failure despite done, metadata-only media and denied probes. No new testcases/files/comments/dependencies/framework. Historical guides, router, assertions, personas, first prompts, comparison budgets and evidence remain unchanged; only new frozen inputs use these corrections.

Parent: please run both fresh independent Standards and Spec source axes at this exact head; the 467cd06a verdict does not cover this logic. Keep draft. No paid/model/preflight/account calls, external active/private artifacts, source-worktree access, browser/Docker/installer runtime, live Project, protected files, child agents or external process intervention occurred.

The separate 42-conversation comparison remains unauthorized. Proposed Sonnet 5.5 agent/person, Opus 5.5 judge, equal 16 turns, parallelism 4, 900/300/600-second task/person/judge timeouts (120-second preflights): at most 672 agent + 672 person + 42 judge + 2 preflight = 1,388 CLI model invocations, not API requests or a dollar guarantee. Explicit call/spend approval and an enforceable monetary cap are required before any paid launch; complete judgments/aggregation and viewer/human acceptance remain pending.

Source-only correction pushed at 16571438bc18d9c0914cf1f4c3af512c427d78df, preserving 3c9f1372 and concurrent history.

Both reported Spec P2s are addressed:
- Verification freshness includes timestamped host/Docker mutation attempts using the existing host_change/docker_mutating classifiers. Failed attempts also stale Status until fresh verification; read-only observations do not. No probes or permissions added.
- All four newcomers, including WSL, get a separate blind Recap assessment in the existing judge call: every App’s purpose/Address, Home folder and credential pointer without secrets. New-schema criteria and filtered verified inventory are fingerprint-bound. Missing/malformed assessments or inputs prevent grading; negative assessments produce separate failed acceptance and viewer notes, without changing original assertion totals/rates. Historical judgment contracts remain unchanged.

Passed all 60 existing offline tests, Ruff lint/format, Pyright, diff checks and the full documented Go gate. Extended existing bodies demonstrate late successful/failed mutations and re-verification, each missing Recap field with all original assertions passing, malformed/missing assessments, and stale input rejection. No new testcase/file/comment/dependency/framework. Guides/router, personas, first prompts, assertions and 16-turn parity are unchanged; historical raw evidence/verdicts were neither read nor modified.

Parent: BOTH fresh independent Standards and Spec source axes are required at this exact final head; earlier verdicts are not reused. Keep draft. Paid comparison (1,388 CLI-invocation ceiling), explicit USD authorization/enforceable cap and human acceptance remain unauthorized/pending. No real-model/preflight/account checks, runtime, private artifacts or children were used.

Both fresh independent SOURCE review axes pass with zero findings at 16571438bc18d9c0914cf1f4c3af512c427d78df (fixed 3800111d292005af38221da47845956694956185). Both prior P2s are resolved: host/Docker mutation attempts invalidate old verification; all four newcomer Recaps receive separate blind, fingerprint-bound assessment in the existing judge call. Missing/malformed/stale assessments block grading, inadequate Recaps fail acceptance without altering original assertion totals. Historical guides/prompts/budgets/evidence remain unchanged; reported offline gates belong to this pin, not real-model acceptance. Keep draft: exact 42-conversation comparison, 1,388-CLI-call ceiling, explicit monetary authorization plus enforceable cap, complete judgments/aggregation/viewer and human feedback remain unmet. No paid calls or live-host probes were run by these reviews.

Pushed 3d1ad0de: iteration 14 remains invalid and ungraded. Offline red/green reproductions identified inherited file-backed stdout/stderr and archived-fixture symlink metadata failures. The final trusted synchronous pipe relay preserves full stdout/stderr and exit status without reopening agent-writable paths outside isolation. Both independent reviewers cleared the final changes; all 60 existing offline tests, Ruff lint/format and Pyright pass. The prepared-runner test now exercises the actual guarded launch path. Frozen guides, assertions and equal 16-turn budgets stay unchanged; fresh smoke precedes any full comparison. PR remains draft pending accepted current-input comparison and human viewer feedback.

Iteration 15 is valid current-input MacBook smoke: both guides completed, no denials/errors; original 5 turns, revised 7. Complete blind judgments + scripted grading: 11/12 each, all eight scripted checks pass, both separate Recap assessments pass. Overall acceptance_passed remains false due the original plain-language assertion. Caveats retained: that criterion partly conflicts with prescribed experience/credential/Home-folder wording; original media-choice pass was lenient on a volunteered person preference rather than an explicit offer. Supplied aggregation/viewer generated with corrected actual model and single-repetition provenance and opened for human feedback. No general improvement claim. Ledger pushed as 3d4844cc. The previously authorized 42-run comparison is now running as fresh iteration 16 (seven scenarios × two frozen guides × three repetitions; equal 16-turn limits, parallelism 2). No fallback/model/billing change. PR remains draft pending full valid execution, complete judgments/viewer and human acceptance.

Iteration 16 is invalid: 20/42 completed, 22 failed/cancelled; no judgments, grades or benchmark. Revised public-Access run 2 safely refused publication: approval covered paperless.example.com only, but the fixture CLI plan offered paperless-ngx.example.com. Offline actual fixture-plan invocation reproduced the mismatch. Production internal/service/cloudflare.go also constructs the hostname from App ID + main domain, so inventing fixture hostname support would be incorrect. The frozen success scenario demands an unsupported exact name yet requires successful publication; safe refusal cannot complete it. Evidence retained unchanged; ledger pushed as 257c118f, lint/typecheck pass. Decision pending: correct success scenario to the supported Address, or turn this into a refusal scenario with revised assertions/completion. Either needs fresh inputs and a new authorized comparison; the single authorized full comparison was consumed. PR stays draft. Iteration 15 remains valid smoke, with supplied viewer and human feedback pending.

User chose the supported Address and explicitly authorized one fresh 42-run comparison. Pushed 4d625af4: only eval 3 first request/persona now asks for paperless-ngx.example.com. Assertions, completion criteria, fixtures, frozen guides/router and budgets are unchanged. Existing execution-boundary test failed against the old unsupported-name request, then passed after correction; existing runner completion/freshness coverage for every scenario, Ruff lint/format and Pyright also pass. Iteration 16 remains invalid/ungraded and untouched. Fresh iteration 17 full comparison is running with corrected frozen inputs, same first-party subscription and selected models, no paid fallback. Stop on failure/quota; judgments only after valid complete execution. Current public-scenario results must not be represented as a same-input rerun of iteration 16. Human feedback remains pending; keep draft.

Iteration 17 is invalid due to subscription quota: 32/42 conversations completed, 10 failed/cancelled. Revised Mint run 3 failed on turn 4 with Claude session-limit error; reported reset 12:40 Europe/Paris. All six corrected public-Access conversations completed, but this is execution evidence only, not assertion or approval acceptance. No partial judgments, grades or benchmark; frozen evidence retained untouched. Model calls stopped with no fallback/model/billing change or automatic retry. The authorized retry is consumed; a fresh complete batch after quota recovery requires renewed authorization. Ledger committed/pushed as 00fb3d2a; lint/format/typecheck pass. Iteration 15 remains valid smoke with human viewer feedback pending. Keep PR draft.

User reported Claude access restored and instructed continuation. Both selected Sonnet/Opus access preflights passed; fresh iteration 18 full comparison is running (seven corrected scenarios × two unchanged frozen guides × three repetitions; equal 16-turn limits, parallelism 2). Iteration 17 remains invalid, ungraded and untouched. Existing first-party subscription only: no paid fallback, model switch or billing change. Stop on quota/execution failure; complete valid execution precedes blind judgments and grading. Ledger pushed as f63abd5a; lint/format/typecheck pass. PR remains draft pending complete comparison, supplied viewer and human feedback.

Iteration 18 is invalid: 36/42 completed, six failed/cancelled after original-guide Mint run 2 exhausted the equal 16-turn limit. No partial judgments, grades or benchmark. The person reported manually running sudo usermod -aG docker sam and logging out/back in, but fixture Doctor kept reporting permission denied. Source inspection: completed_steps/state application models only Docker Desktop/WSL; Mint docker_group changes only when agent commands reach the host stub, not when the person reports a requested manual step. Proposed correction reuses that explicit manual-step mechanism for permitted, requested, completed Mint group/login actions, with platform/request validation and offline regression. Do not increase turn budget or invent terminal observations. Frozen evidence remains untouched; decision/new batch authorization pending. Ledger pushed as 58c21fb6; lint/format/typecheck pass. No further model calls or fallback. Keep PR draft; valid iteration 15 viewer feedback remains pending.

Pushed 8403ff89: narrow Mint manual Docker-group/login completion now reuses the structured WSL mechanism with trusted scenario allowlists, platform/request validation, explicit persona permission, and fresh verification after marker changes. No guides, assertions or budgets changed. Existing runner regression went red before correction; review follow-ups for split flags/sign-out wording and rejecting Docker service restart as login refresh also went red before fixes. Both independent review axes cleared final source/docs; all 60 offline tests, Ruff lint/format and Pyright pass. An intermediate full-suite timeout is retained in the ledger; focused network canary and fresh complete suite passed without relaxing isolation. The user authorized Mint smoke only: iteration 19 is running one conversation per unchanged frozen guide, same models and equal 16-turn limits. No full batch authorized yet; historical iteration 18 remains invalid and ungraded. Keep draft pending accepted full comparison and human viewer feedback.

Pushed c287393c after invalid iteration 19 (1/2 completed, no judgments/grades). Diagnosed two fixture issues: malformed sudo usermod without a username falsely changed Docker-group state; requested logout/login after an agent-applied change required repeating the earlier command. Fixed exact fixture-user/argument validation and follow-up completion using prior validated group state plus a fresh login request/verification. Mint whoami/id -un now return explicit fixture identity only; unmodeled identity never falls back to the relay. Extended existing approved runner/execution regressions red→green, including username suffixes/trailing flags and service-restart controls. All 60 offline tests, final focused regression, Ruff lint/format and Pyright pass; both review axes cleared follow-ups. User instructed continued iteration. Fresh iteration 20 is running one Mint conversation per unchanged frozen guide, equal 16-turn budgets and unchanged assertions. Historical failed evidence remains untouched/ungraded; no model/billing switch or paid fallback. PR stays draft pending valid full comparison, supplied viewer and human feedback.

Iteration 20 Mint smoke is valid and completely judged/graded: revised 11/12, original 10/12; all eight scripted checks and both separate blind Recap assessments pass. Neither acceptance_passed is true because original assertions failed. Both conversations completed with no denials/errors (revised four turns; original three). Supplied aggregation/static viewer generated and opened with actual model/repetition metadata and caveats. Plain-language grading partly conflicts with required Docker experience wording; revised also leaked internal Experience wording, original used sudo/config jargon. Original did not offer both media choices but person had already volunteered no-download preference; judge failed it here unlike iteration 15. Verdicts retained, inconsistency flagged; one-point difference is not proof of overall superiority. These are fixtures, not native installations. Ledger pushed as f015cbee; lint/format/Pyright pass. Full seven-scenario × two-guide × three-repeat comparison and human feedback still outstanding; keep draft. No automatic quota retry, model/billing switch or paid fallback.

Pushed 23c94251: expanded from seven to nine conversation scenarios at the user’s request, adding declined additional installation and declined public Access on the existing Jellyfin/Paperless fixture. Original seven definitions/assertions and both frozen guides are unchanged. New no_change completion requires successful Status, unchanged Apps/Access and no Project/Host/Docker mutation attempts, including failed attempts; text/refusal quality remains blind-judged. Runner CLI test red→green; missing Status/install/host privilege/Docker/publication controls rejected. Shared-fixture regression surfaced red and was fixed with eval-ID workspaces and a no-change-aware fake positive path. All 61 offline tests, Ruff lint/format and Pyright pass; both review axes cleared final changes. Real-model runs for the additions remain pending. Iteration 21 original 42-run comparison hit subscription quota before any completion (0/42, reset reported 6:50pm Europe/Paris); retained invalid/ungraded, no fallback or automatic retry. Expanded nine-case comparison is 54 conversations and needs bounded authorization plus model access preflights. Keep draft; full valid evidence and human viewer feedback still required. Guide changes stay in separate #257.

User explicitly authorized the expanded nine-scenario × two-guide × three-repeat comparison (54 conversations), equal 16-turn limits, blind judgments/viewer only after complete valid execution. After the reported reset time, both selected Sonnet and Opus access preflights passed; fresh iteration 22 is running with parallelism 2. Historical quota-blocked iteration 21 remains untouched/ungraded. Original seven definitions, assertions and guides are unchanged; new IDs 7–8 add refusal coverage, so this is an expanded comparison rather than a same-input rerun of iteration 21. Stop on any quota/execution failure with no fallback or automatic retry. Authorization ledger pushed as 6d5269a9; lint/format/Pyright pass. Keep draft pending complete trustworthy evidence and human feedback; guide improvements remain separate in #257.

Iteration 22 invalid/ungraded: 29/54 completed; 25 failed/cancelled at revised Mint run 1. Clean fixture environment lacked USER, so sudo -n usermod -aG docker $USER became a missing-user command and correctly failed. Agent then handed off the valid manual $USER command/logout-login, but validator only accepted literal usernames. Both symptoms red-reproduced at existing runner/execution seams. Pushed 3987c7b3: USER is set only from trusted fixture metadata, never relay identity; manual matching preserves command case and supports fixture identity variables/existing modeled identity commands with expansion-safe quoting. Wrong-case commands/variables, literal single-quoted variables and malformed targets remain refused. All 61 offline tests, Ruff lint/format and Pyright pass; both independent review axes cleared final fixes. Original nine eval definitions, guides, assertions and budgets unchanged. Historical attempts remain frozen/ungraded. No further model run or fallback; fresh bounded authorization due. PR stays draft, guide improvements separate in #257.

User selected the bounded six-conversation Mint smoke after 3987c7b3 (three repetitions per unchanged frozen guide, equal 16-turn limits). Both selected Sonnet/Opus access preflights passed. Fresh iteration 23 is running with parallelism 2; complete blind judgments and supplied viewer only if all six executions are valid. No fresh full batch is authorized by this selection. Stop on quota/failure, no fallback or automatic retry. Iteration 22 remains invalid and ungraded; keep draft.

Iteration 23 six-run Mint smoke invalid/ungraded: five completed; original run 3 repeated docker_group_login at person turn 6 after it was already validated/applied at turn 4. Latest reply requested no new login, so the runner rejected the historical label as a new action. No judgments/grades/benchmark and failed evidence untouched. Red-reproduced duplicate at existing runner CLI seam; pushed 3a56aa2c with per-conversation applied-step tracking, explicit person prompt history/new-only reporting, and idempotent duplicate handling. A repeat is retained in raw logs but cannot reapply state/update marker timestamps; first/unknown reports still require original allowlist/platform/request checks. Regression also rejects duplicate completion after a later failed host mutation with stale verification. All 61 offline tests, Ruff lint/format and Pyright pass; both review axes cleared the fix. Guides/assertions/budgets unchanged. No new model run or automatic retry; renewed bounded authorization due. Keep draft; full valid comparison and human viewer feedback remain pending.

User renewed authorization for Mint smoke only: six conversations (three per unchanged guide), equal 16-turn limits, judgments/viewer only after all executions are valid. Both selected-model preflights passed. Fresh iteration 24 is running with the idempotence fix 3a56aa2c, parallelism 2. No full comparison authorized by this selection; stop on failure/quota without fallback or automatic retry. Earlier invalid attempts remain unchanged and ungraded. Keep draft.

Iteration 24 is valid and completely judged/graded: all six Mint conversations (three per guide) completed with zero denials/errors. Revised 10/12, 11/12, 11/12 (32/36); original 10/12 ×3 (30/36). All eight scripted checks in every run and all six separate blind Recap assessments pass, but every acceptance_passed remains false because original assertions failed. Supplied aggregation/viewer generated and opened with actual model/repetition metadata and caveats. All runs fail plain-language grading: required Docker experience question partly conflicts with criterion, alongside real jargon/Status wording/Home-folder issues. Revised offered both media choices 2/3 vs original 0/3, but some people volunteered a settled preference/folder; strict grading and iteration-15 leniency flagged without rewriting verdicts. Three Mint repetitions are not a full nine-scenario quality or native-installation proof. Ledger pushed c697acd2; lint/format/Pyright pass. Fresh bounded full comparison and human viewer feedback remain outstanding; no full batch authorized by the smoke selection. Keep draft; guide improvements separate #257.

User asked to continue the unfinished work in response to the pending full 54-conversation proposal. Fresh iteration 25 is running: nine scenarios × both unchanged frozen guides × three repetitions, equal 16-turn limits, parallelism 2. Sonnet/Opus access checks passed. Complete blind judgments and supplied viewer only after complete valid execution; stop on failure/quota with no automatic retry or fallback. Earlier failures remain frozen/ungraded. GitHub confirms #257 is already merged; subsequent guide improvements will use a separate follow-up PR, not this harness PR. Keep draft until valid full evidence and human viewer feedback.

Iteration 25 execution is complete and valid: 54/54 conversations, zero failed/cancelled. All nine scenarios, both unchanged frozen guides and three repetitions ran at the same 16-turn limit. Complete blind Opus judgments and separate newcomer Recap assessments are now running; no partial grades or quality/acceptance claims. Supplied aggregation/viewer and evidence-based follow-up guide changes come after complete judgments.

Iteration 25: all 54 conversation executions are valid (zero failed/cancelled), but complete blind judging hit Claude subscription quota: resets 12pm Europe/Paris. Forty-eight responses with usage remain as raw diagnostics; the failed batch correctly invalidated all judgment metrics and removed usable verdicts. Zero grading files, benchmark or viewer; no partial score or quality claim. Model usage stopped, no fallback or automatic retry. Execution evidence and failed judge diagnostics are preserved; further guide changes are not inferred from incomplete judgments. Next step after restored access and separate bounded authorization is a fresh judgment-only attempt on copies of the valid frozen conversations, not another 54-conversation batch. Ledger pushed as 3558e581; Ruff lint/format and Pyright pass. Keep draft and human review gate. #257 has merged, so future guide revisions require a separate follow-up PR.
